products.name: HardID Hardware Wallet
products.summary: Fully open-source, air-gapped hardware wallet. Keys never leave the device — what you see is what you sign.

specs.secure_elements: Dual EAL6+ secure elements (MCU stores no key material)
specs.connection: Air-gapped via QR code; USB for FIDO2
specs.seed: BIP39 offline generation, 12/18/24 words, shown once, never exported
specs.pin: Exponential backoff capped at 24h; optional duress PIN decoy wallet
specs.extra_security: Optional 25th-word passphrase hidden wallets; secure boot with ECDSA firmware verification and anti-rollback
specs.license: Apache 2.0 (open hardware, open firmware, open tools)

products.name: BitExchange Hardware Wallet (2014)
products.summary: Early hardware wallet that laid the technical foundation and design philosophy for HardID. Historical product.

specs.security: PIN code + seed phrase (on-device signing, private key never touches the network)

products.status: historical — no longer manufactured; foundation for HardID

products.name: CryoSpring 冷泉 — Immersion Liquid Cooling
products.summary: Phase-change immersion liquid cooling for Bitcoin mining ASICs. Fully submerges heat sources in coolant for ultimate thermal performance.

specs.method: Immersion phase-change cooling (heat sources fully submerged in coolant)
benefits: Supports overclocking, reducing per-unit hashrate cost
